Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
8:00 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core Ultra 5/7 chip.

Memory: 16 GB is the floor. 8 GB gets slow with a code editor, a browser and Docker open together. Pick one where memory can be upgraded.
Screen and keyboard: A full HD (1920×1080) screen or better, at least 300 nits bright, and a comfortable keyboard. You'll look at both all day.
Battery and weight: Look for 8+ hours of real use and under 1.8 kg if you carry it around.
Graphics card: Skip it unless you do games or machine learning. That money is better spent on memory and a better screen.

A MacBook Air with an M-series chip is worth a look if a sale brings it near your budget. I haven't checked current prices, so I won't quote any.

What kind of programming do you do: web and apps, data and machine learning, or games?
